## About Ordelo

Ordelo is a complete, production-grade restaurant platform that runs customer ordering, kitchen workflows, table reservations, delivery dispatch, and admin operations on a single, unified stack. Built with Next.js, Firebase, Firestore, and Stripe — designed for a Bangladeshi restaurant but architected to scale to any multi-branch operation.

### The Problem We Solve

Most restaurant software is a mess of disconnected pieces — a delivery app here, a POS there, a separate reservation tool, and a phone for the rest. The result: orders fall through the cracks, kitchen and delivery get out of sync, and operators waste hours reconciling systems. Ordelo brings it all under one roof.

### Four User Roles, One Platform

- **Customer** — Public site + dashboard. Browse menu, order, pay, track delivery, book tables, manage account.
- **Admin** — `/admin` console. Full operational control: orders, menu, branches, reservations, drivers, analytics, settings.
- **Cook** — Kitchen order screen. Order progression, status updates, limited order-management access.
- **Delivery** — `/driver` dashboard. Assigned-order retrieval, status updates, ETAs, location access.

Every role gets exactly the access they need — no more, no less.

### Three Fulfillment Modes

Every order can be:

- **🛵 Delivery** — Driver assigned, real-time status, ETAs, location access control.
- **🍽️ Dine-In** — Table reservation workflow.
- **🥡 Takeaway** — Quick pickup, minimal friction.

Per-branch fulfillment settings keep each location's capabilities accurate.

### Customer Experience

- **🍽️ Browse & Order** — Localized homepage, menu browsing by category, rich dish details, persistent cart (local-first, synced to Firestore), guest or authenticated checkout, coupon validation, **server-side total calculation** (the price the customer sees is the price they pay — client values are never trusted), and **Stripe Checkout** finalized via webhooks.
- **📦 Track & Manage** — Public order tracking via order ID + email, order cancellation with built-in refund flow, customer dashboard with full order history, in-app notifications with read, clear, and preference toggles.
- **🪑 Table Reservations** — Browse slots, select a table, server-enforced policy on buffer times and per-slot limits, secure cancellation via HMAC-signed, short-lived cancel tokens.
- **🌍 Multilingual by default** — English, Arabic, Filipino, Hindi, Urdu, and Bengali out of the box. RTL-aware layouts for Arabic and Urdu. Admin translation management for ongoing localization.

### Admin Operations

Order management with bulk status updates, dish & category CRUD, coupon CRUD with per-user locks and atomic counters, branch management, reservation management, a visual **floor-plan editor** for table layout, driver account creation and order assignment, restaurant settings and feature flags, analytics dashboard, and customer list and management.

### Driver Experience

Dedicated dashboard at `/driver`, assigned-order retrieval with delivery locations, status progression through `pending → assigned → picked_up → out_for_delivery → delivered`, ETA updates in real time, and strict access control — drivers only see orders and locations assigned to them.

### What Makes Ordelo Different

- **🔐 Security & Integrity** — Server-side order totals, atomic coupon locks via Firestore transactions, Stripe webhook finalization, HMAC-signed cancel tokens, rate limiting on public APIs and checkout, role-based access control at proxy, server, and route layers, settings fail closed.
- **⚡ Performance & Resilience** — In-repo observability for errors and telemetry, public cached reads (e.g. menu), field-masked rate-limited APIs, direct Firestore client reads for real-time admin workflows, property-based testing for invariant correctness.
- **🎨 Polished UX** — 3D visuals with React Three Fiber, Drei, and Three.js, Framer Motion animations, Tailwind CSS 4, real-time notification bell with glow animations and unread badges, maps and geo UI with Leaflet.
- **🧪 Tested end-to-end** — Vitest and Testing Library for unit and component tests, Firebase emulators, custom E2E runner, property-based tests, Jest in legacy paths.

*Customer ordering, kitchen workflows, table reservations, delivery dispatch, and admin operations — one platform, end to end.*

## About Geeb (CNG)

Geeb — the brand for our CNG service marketplace platform — bridges the gap between customers who need a service and the providers who deliver it. It's a full multi-app ecosystem: a customer-facing app, a vendor-facing app, and an admin-facing app, all sharing a single, well-architected backend.

### The Vision

Finding a trusted service provider shouldn't be a gamble. Whether it's a home service, a professional, or a local business, customers deserve to **discover, compare, book, and review** with confidence. Geeb makes that experience seamless for everyone in the loop.

### Three Apps, One Platform

- **📱 Customer App** — Discover nearby and trending vendors, browse by category and area, book, track, and review services, and manage your profile, avatar, and account security.
- **🛠️ Vendor App** — Manage service offerings and delivery areas, receive and respond to customer requests, and track performance via reviews and ratings. Includes OTP-based email verification, Hive-based offline caching, background sync, and smart error handling.
- **🛡️ Admin App** — Monitor the full ecosystem, manage users, vendors, and content, and review system health and security events.
- **📦 Shared Package** — Common widgets, utilities, services, and business logic reused across all three apps for consistency and velocity.

### Feature Highlights

- **🏆 Trending Vendors** — Curated discovery that surfaces the most relevant, highest-rated providers.
- **🏠 Customer Home Screen** — Personalized landing with smart recommendations and quick category access.
- **🗺️ Hierarchical Area System** — Multi-level geographic organization (city → district → neighborhood) for accurate local discovery.
- **🧑 Avatar Management** — Full spec for avatar uploads, storage, and rendering across all apps.
- **🔐 Auth & Security** — Google OAuth, Two-Factor Authentication (TOTP), and OTP-based email verification for vendors — with a professional guided signup and pending-verification recovery flow.
- **⭐ Reviews & Ratings v2.1** — Automatic rating calculation at service and vendor level, real-time UI refresh, cross-app updates via smart polling, and PostgreSQL RLS for secure access.
- **💾 Offline-First Sync** — Hive-based local caching, background data sync, and 5-minute refresh intervals to keep things fast.
- **🧰 Developer-First Foundations** — Strict Android NDK pinning (`29.0.13113456`), iOS 14.0 deployment target, `.vscode/launch.json` ready to go.

### What Geeb Delivers

| For Customers | For Vendors | For Admins |
|---|---|---|
| Easy discovery | Streamlined onboarding | Full ecosystem visibility |
| Trusted reviews | Real-time requests | User & content management |
| Local-area search | Offline-capable app | Security event monitoring |
| Secure account | Performance tracking | Scalable moderation tools |

### Engineering Principles

- **Modular by design** — Easy to expand into new service categories or geographies.
- **Localization-first** — Multi-language support from day one.
- **Security-first** — RLS policies, 2FA, OTP verification, and audit-friendly flows.
- **Accessibility-aware** — Semantic markup, screen-reader friendly UI.
- **Modern Flutter** — Clean architecture shared across customer, vendor, and admin.

*Built for accessibility, localization, and scale. Designed to grow into new industries and regions with the same proven architecture.*

## About Matrix

Matrix is a high-performance, all-in-one SaaS workspace built to replace the patchwork of separate tools most teams juggle. Projects, people, customers, and finances all live in a single, cohesive ecosystem — and the data flows between them.

### The Problem We Solve

Most growing teams stitch together 5–10 different subscriptions: a CRM here, a task manager there, invoicing somewhere else, docs in yet another tab. The result is **tool fatigue**, broken integrations, and data trapped in silos. Matrix exists to eliminate that — one login, one interface, one source of truth.

### Five Modules in One Workspace

- **📊 Project & Task Management** — Kanban workflow with drag-and-drop boards, customizable columns and priorities, task hierarchies with subtasks and full parent–child relationships, real-time collaboration with instant updates across the team.
- **🤝 Customer Relationship Management (CRM)** — Centralized contact database for clients, leads, and stakeholders, a sales pipeline that tracks every customer from first lead to closed deal, and full engagement tracking with interaction history and status monitoring.
- **👥 Human Resource Management (HRM)** — Employee directory with detailed records, full lifecycle management from onboarding through performance tracking, and granular workspace roles for precise permission control.
- **🧾 Professional Invoicing** — Generate professional invoices with built-in **Stripe** integration, automated status tracking (Draft, Paid, Overdue) updated in real time, and itemized billing with detailed line items, tax, and quantity calculations.
- **📄 Document & Knowledge Management** — Collaborative docs with internal and external sharing on the same document, full version control that tracks every change and reverts to any previous version, and granular public/private access control.

### Enterprise-Grade from Day One

- **🔀 Multi-Workspace Support** — Seamlessly switch between organizations or departments.
- **📜 Audit Logging** — Complete traceability of actions for security and compliance.
- **🔒 Secure Multi-Tenancy** — Hard data isolation between workspaces.
- **📈 Scalable Architecture** — Built for horizontal scaling from the ground up.

### Built on a Modern, High-Performance Stack

A stack chosen for **speed, security, and developer experience** — and one that translates into a noticeably faster product for end users.

- **Frontend** — Next.js 15 (App Router) + TypeScript
- **Backend** — Bun + Elysia.js (ultra-low latency)
- **Database** — PostgreSQL via Prisma ORM
- **Caching** — Redis (sessions + performance)
- **Auth** — Better Auth (RBAC + multi-tenancy)
- **UI/UX** — Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui

### Why Matrix

- **Replace 5+ tools** with one subscription.
- **Stop losing context** between modules — data flows, not fragments.
- **Built to scale** with multi-workspace and multi-tenant architecture from day one.
- **Modern UX** — clean, accessible, fast.

*Developed with a focus on rich aesthetics, performance, and developer experience.*

## About nomu

nomu is a mobile habit and life-tracking application built with Flutter. It's designed around a single idea: **growth is a daily practice**, and the right tools should make that practice effortless, private, and yours forever.

### Why nomu Exists

Most habit apps want your data, your account, and your monthly fee. nomu is built on the opposite principles:

- **Local-first** — Your data lives on your device.
- **Offline by default** — No account required, no internet required.
- **No subscriptions, no ads, no tracking.**
- **Full backup & restore** — You own your data, always.

### What You Can Track

- **🌱 Core Growth Modules**
  - **Habits** — Daily, weekly, or custom-frequency habits with streaks, scoring, and rich history.
  - **Goals** — Long-term goals linked to the habits that drive them.
  - **Tasks** — One-off and recurring to-dos with reminders.
  - **Reminders** — Smart notifications that nudge you at the right time.
  - **My Day** — A unified daily view that brings habits, tasks, and goals into one screen.
- **💪 Health** — Water, sleep, weight, and food logging. Health module designed to extend into workout tracking (roadmap).
- **🕌 Islamic** — Prayer tracking with scoring. Fasting and nafila (voluntary) tracking.
- **💾 Backup & Restore** — Full local backup and restore of all your data.
- **🧭 Supporting Experience** — Onboarding, Home (at-a-glance daily dashboard), Profile (personal stats and history), Settings (full control, including a "reset all data" option), and built-in Help.

### What Makes nomu Different

| | nomu | Typical habit apps |
|---|---|---|
| Account required | ❌ No | ✅ Yes |
| Works offline | ✅ Fully | ⚠️ Limited |
| Your data lives on your device | ✅ Yes | ❌ On their servers |
| Subscription | ❌ None | 💲 Monthly fee |
| Ads & trackers | ❌ None | ✅ Usually yes |
| Backup & restore | ✅ Built-in | ⚠️ Varies |
| Localization | ✅ Arabic + English (RTL-aware) | ⚠️ English-first |

### Built Right

- **Flutter + Dart** — Native performance on iOS and Android from a single codebase.
- **Riverpod** for state management.
- **sqflite** for local data storage.
- **go_router** for navigation.
- **Feature-first architecture** — Each feature (habits, goals, health, islamic…) is self-contained, making the app easy to extend and maintain.

### Roadmap Highlights

- **Phase 1 (2026)** — Polish & stability: better empty states, habit editing that preserves streaks, health trend indicators, and RTL fixes.
- **Phase 2 (2026)** — Workout & physical activity tracking, integrated with the existing health module and habit system.
- **Phase 3 (2026–2027)** — Wellness & mental health: tracking how you *felt*, not just what you *did*.
- **Phase 4+** — Wearable integrations, HealthKit, and beyond.

*Built as a focused side project with a clear philosophy: your growth, your data, your pace.*

### For Users Who Care About Privacy

nomu was designed for people who don't want another cloud account, another data breach risk, or another subscription that disappears. If that sounds like you, nomu is built for you.
